name: Pittsburgh International Race Complex (Full Course)

career.lengthSource: Pittsburgh International Race Complex official site | https://www.pittrace.com/post/hooked-on-driving
career.layoutCall: Full course, North and South tracks combined, 19 turns, 2.8 mi (4.506 km): F1600 Championship Series, August 2019. The 2017 repave's chicane before T16 predates his race. The venue closed on 9 November 2025 and was sold; OSM still carried the circuit when read on 17 November 2026 (research notes table). OSM's one loop measures 4386 m, 2.7% under the published length.
